guardrails.clinical_condition: Incidental myocardial bone-tracer uptake on a non-amyloidosis scan
guardrails.message: Do not classify as ATTRwt from uptake alone; route through monoclonal evaluation and definitive ATTR typing.
Mild sensory neuropathy does not automatically imply ATTRv; prominent painful/autonomic phenotype routes to WT28.

guardrails.clinical_condition: Female ATTR-like phenotype with low conventional septal thickness
guardrails.message: Low septal thickness contributes zero negative evidence; use broader phenotype and sex/body-size-aware LVMI context.
Monoclonal evidence changes the diagnostic pathway and does not automatically prove AL or negate coexisting ATTR.

guardrails.clinical_condition: Abnormal FLC ratio with reduced eGFR
guardrails.message: Use assay/eGFR-specific interpretation and immunofixation context; do not manufacture monoclonality from renal clearance shift.
Route urgently toward AL/renal differential; do not implement as absolute ATTR exclusion.

guardrails.clinical_condition: Prominent painful neuropathy, marked dysautonomia/GI dysfunction, family or ocular signs
guardrails.message: Older age and absent family history do not establish wild type.

guardrails.clinical_condition: Active chronic inflammatory/infectious driver + persistent burden + renal protein-loss transition
guardrails.message: Driver alone is insufficient; require ordered multi-part phenotype.
